brief: Six AI business types you can start in 2026 — productized service, micro-SaaS, course, newsletter, agency, info product. Pros, cons, target operator.

slots.headline: 6 AI Business Types to Launch in 2026
slots.body: AI is reshaping every industry. Discover six proven business models you can start this year, each with clear pros, cons, and the ideal operator. Save this guide for quick reference.

slots.title: Productized AI Service
slots.body: Pros: predictable revenue, scalable delivery. Cons: limited customization, requires strong SOPs. Ideal for operators with domain expertise who love repeatable processes.

slots.title: Micro‑SaaS AI Tool
slots.body: Pros: low overhead, subscription cash‑flow. Cons: heavy dev maintenance, niche market risk. Best for tech‑savvy founders comfortable with coding and product iteration.

slots.title: AI Masterclass Course
slots.body: Pros: high margin, authority building. Cons: content upkeep, requires teaching skill. Suits educators or consultants who enjoy curriculum design and community engagement.

slots.title: AI Insights Newsletter
slots.body: Pros: recurring income, audience growth. Cons: constant content grind, subscriber churn. Ideal for writers who love curating trends and nurturing a niche readership.

slots.title: AI Solutions Agency
slots.body: Pros: high ticket projects, client relationships. Cons: scaling bottleneck, sales dependency. Perfect for experienced marketers or consultants who thrive on bespoke implementations.

slots.title: AI Info Product Pack
slots.body: Pros: easy to bundle, passive sales. Cons: market saturation, requires strong brand. Fits creators with a loyal following who can package expertise into ebooks or templates.

slots.headline: Pick Your AI Venture Today
slots.body: Ready to launch? Choose a model that matches your strengths and start building in 2026.
